title: TAVELO ARDEN: Miglior Bici Allround del 2026?

takeaways.text: He presents the Arden as a more comfortable, all-round sibling of the very stiff Arow, which some riders found punishing over long rides.
Tavelo lists 34 mm with a double chainring; he says a 1× setup accepts up to 40 mm. That is his claim, above the 38 mm 1× figure on Tavelo's current page.
Compared with the Arow, it adds a UDH hanger and swaps the press-fit bottom bracket for a threaded 68 mm BSA shell.
The Arden has more stack from a taller head tube; the geometry looks close to the Arow on paper, and he compares the position to a Tarmac SL8.
He says the SL version claims 690 g in Toray T1100 and the Race version, made from T800 and M46, is about 100 g heavier.
He quotes US$1,899 for the Race frameset kit and US$2,299 for the SL, and says the price increase reflects higher quality.

disclosure: Unboxing of an Arden Race frameset by a channel that says it works with Tavelo daily; the supply terms are not stated.
summary: Italian-language unboxing and overview of the Tavelo Arden Race frameset and how it differs from the Arow.
